ApplicationJob.UserNotes: Downloads new main-branch commits from GitHub and extracts them to Package. Update downloads only; choose Install to apply the downloaded version. Supports ASUS computers whose Armoury Crate service exposes compatible operating modes; no exact model restriction. ASUS services are required. The separate Armoury Crate Modes desktop menu works with Game Library disabled. Setup offers Top/Bottom desktop placement.
ApplicationJob.Name: ASUS\Armory Crate Mode
